transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus public target. The target preserves the Rust 1.96 body `self.strip_prefix(prefix)?.strip_suffix(suffix)` as an explicit `let Some(stripped) = strip_prefix(slice, prefix) else { return None; }; strip_suffix(stripped, suffix)` early-return lowering with only the receiver named `slice`.
Instantiated reviewed strip_prefix and strip_suffix contracts locally so the public target calls the same prefix-removal and suffix-removal relations rather than assuming the circumfix postcondition.

Reused the sibling SlicePattern::as_slice, slice PartialEq prefix/suffix comparison, and split_at/range-view facts as narrow target-local boundaries; the public strip_circumfix target is not external_body.

Attached the generated `slice_strip_circumfix_result`, `slice_strip_prefix_result`, `slice_strip_suffix_result`, `slice_is_prefix`, `slice_is_suffix`, and `slice_pattern_view` vocabulary and proved the prefix-then-suffix subrange composition for the executable target.
